google-maps.name: Google Maps MCP Server
google-maps.description: Provides location search, geocoding, and distance calculation capabilities via Google Maps APIs.

tools.name: search_location
tools.description: Search for locations, places, or addresses using Google Maps API.

query.description: Name, address, or keyword of the location.

location_bias.description: Optional latitude,longitude string for location bias.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Search for top 5 highly-rated and popular restaurants or eateries in a specific location or area.

location.description: Name of the station, area, neighborhood, or city (e.g. '강남역', 'Seoul Station').

tools.name: calculate_distance
tools.description: Calculate travel distance and estimated duration between origin and destination.

origin.description: Starting address, place name, or lat,lng coordinates.

destination.description: Destination address, place name, or lat,lng coordinates.
